name: photo-paper-scene-zine-v1
title_zh: 照片变纸艺场景志，主体不动四周撕纸重构
tagline_zh: 想要复古拼贴却怕丢主体？它只撕掉背景，用单色半调、老化纤维和留白重建场景，附中英双语小字排版，像手工杂志内页。
tagline_en: Keep the real subject, rebuild the scene with torn paper, halftone fields, aged fibers, and bilingual editorial.
desc_en: Transform a user-supplied photograph into a quiet paper-scene zine poster that preserves the real subject while rebuilding the surrounding scene with layered torn paper, a restrained single-color halftone or risograph field, aged fibers, generous negative space, and small Chinese, English, or bilingual editorial text. Use when the user asks for a vintage photo collage, torn-paper scene poster, blu
why_zh: 不是无脑滤镜，而是先识别主体再分层撕纸重构，单色半调克制不抢戏，负空间和文字排版让成品直接可印。
why_en: It doesn't just filter—it detects the subject, rebuilds surroundings with layered torn paper and restrained halftone, leaving.
limit_zh: 只接受单张照片输入，输出为单页海报式构图；不处理多图拼贴、不生成可编辑矢量文件，文字排版固定为三种预设样式。
limit_en: Single photo in, one-page poster out. No multi-image collage, no editable vector output; text layout limited to three presets—manual tweaks needed.
